name: hvp
description: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion, feature outline (Go to Symbol), and block-imbalance diagnostics for the HVP (Hierarchical Verification Plan) language.
author: Ilia Barkov

hvp.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a local `hvp-language-server` checkout's launcher (e.g. `/path/to/hvp-language-server/bin/hvp-language-server.js`), for developing against a build of the server other than the one bundled into this extension at build time. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

hvp.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the HVP language server.

hvp.modifiers.files.markdownDescription: Modifier files to preview, as the `-mod` argument list would name them: a `file:` URI, an absolute path, or a path relative to a workspace folder. When set, `override` statements are applied to the values shown on hover and features a `filter` removes are marked as removed. Empty (the default) shows the plan as written, with no modifier applied.

hvp.modifiers.date.markdownDescription: The date `until` branches are evaluated against, as `MM-DD-YYYY` (the format the language chapter's own examples use, e.g. `04-30-2014`). Empty (the default) uses today, so a branch expires on the day it says it does.
